purpose: Operator rollback procedure to restore Native default when LangGraph opt-in is causing problems
rollback_triggers: backend_fallback_used is true and backend_fallback_reason indicates LangGraph unavailable
LangGraph runs time out or fail repeatedly
Dashboard shows unexpected backend or provider degradation
Operator decides to exit LangGraph opt-in experiment

rollback_steps.action: Stop the Brain V9 server process.
Unset AGENT_V2_BACKEND in the current session.
If set at process level, clear it.
If set at machine level and should no longer apply, clear it (requires admin).
Start the server without LangGraph opt-in.
Run the smoke validation matrix for Native default.

notes: No source code changes are required for rollback; the selector guard already falls back to Native when AGENT_V2_BACKEND is unset or invalid.
Run artifacts from LangGraph opt-in sessions are isolated to their caller-provided run_root and do not corrupt production RUN_ROOT.
Native runtime is the only production-supported backend at the 08F5 closeout stage.
